findings.message: The source identifies the proposition as a scholarly view but does not establish that it is disputed or identify a competing view. Marking it as "disputed" asserts an unresolved conflict not shown by the bounded source.
findings.recommended_action: Replace the unsupported disputed characterization with a status limited to the reported doctrinal authority, or expressly leave the status unresolved for review without inferring a competing position.

findings.message: The set marks every card as review-required and identifies unresolved issues in review_notes, including the authority of the scholarly view, intent and reinvestment conditions, and the distinction between fraud benefit and the Special Economic Crimes Act benefit amount, but provides no review questions.
findings.recommended_action: Add narrowly framed legal-review questions corresponding to the unresolved matters already identified in the cards, without selecting answers or adding unsupported authority.

summary: The cards generally preserve the validated candidates and their reported authority, but the first card unsupportedly labels a merely reported scholarly view as disputed, and the card set omits required review questions despite multiple expressly unresolved issues.
